name: Maaya Rajeshwaran Revathi
bio:
Career Overview: Maaya Rajeshwaran Revathi is an emerging Indian player starting her professional journey on the ITF circuit.

Playing Style: Known for her steady baseline play and developing all-around skills, with a preference for hard courts.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #797 (December 23, 2024)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #1039 (December 23, 2024)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to compete in Grand Slam qualifying; early in her pro career.

Notable Achievements:
  • Competed in $15K ITF events, reaching early rounds as she builds experience.

Other Highlights:
  • A young talent with roots in Tamil Nadu, Maaya is gaining attention for her potential in Indian tennis.
